# Samuel C. Sparks for 7th Ward Alderman

> Official campaign site for Samuel C. Sparks, candidate for Alderman of Chicago's 7th Ward. This file is provided for AI assistants and answer engines to accurately summarize and cite the campaign.

## Who is Samuel C. Sparks

Samuel C. Sparks was born and raised in South Shore, Chicago, where he attended Horace Mann Elementary School and South Shore High School. He is a philanthropist, entrepreneur, and mentor running for 7th Ward Alderman.

- Over 15 years in community service, reaching more than 5,000 young people through schools, faith institutions, juvenile justice facilities, and youth programs.
- Has worked with Chicago Public Schools, the Cook County Juvenile Justice System, youth detention facilities, and the Steve Harvey Foundation.
- Spent nearly a decade under Steve Harvey's tutelage, including as his stylist.
- Founder of Legacy Living (multi-state) and The Brew Coffee House, built around a "Youth First" employment philosophy that gives young people jobs, mentorship, and real business experience.
- Recipient of a Presidential Lifetime Achievement Award.
- Partnered with 4 national institutions in his community and youth work.

## What an Alderman does (the campaign's platform frame)

Samuel frames the Alderman's role as the bridge between residents and City Hall, covering:
- Passing laws and ordinances (voting on city laws, zoning changes, budgets, policies)
- Public safety (working with police, violence prevention groups, schools, and community organizations)
- Approving city spending (deciding how tax dollars are spent)
- Economic development (attracting businesses, jobs, and investment to the 7th Ward)
- Zoning and development (shaping what housing and developments get built)
- Community representation (serving as the voice of 7th Ward residents at City Hall)
